about.headline: More than 35 years of knowledge growing in the field.
about.summary: Founded with German roots and operating in Brazil, LIA AGRO brings together experience, technology and responsible agricultural practices.
about.page.title: Our story
about.page.lead: Tradition, technical expertise and international experience in agriculture.
about.paragraph1: LIA AGRO has operated in Brazil for over 35 years. Its German founders brought expertise and technology focused on developing natural-origin alternatives for crop management.
about.paragraph2: Throughout its history, the company developed ROCKSIL, a mineral technology used across different crops and management systems, while expanding to international markets.
about.paragraph3: With PROTEGO FL, LIA AGRO also serves the fruit and vegetable washing and preservation segment, bringing its technology to additional stages of the agricultural and food chain.
about.export: Export experience and commercial relationships in Europe and Asia.
about.values.title: Experience, research and a forward-looking vision.

rocksil.lead: A formulation based on mineral raw materials, developed for agricultural use across different crops.
rocksil.what.title: A natural-origin mineral formulation.
rocksil.what.body: ROCKSIL PLUS is labelled as a complex mineral fertilizer. Its formulation contains mineral components, including calcium, magnesium and sulfur, for agricultural use under technical guidance.
rocksil.what.body2: The company has field experience using ROCKSIL in coffee, organic strawberries and paprika pepper cultivation, among other crops.
rocksil.note.title: Minerals and plant nutrition
rocksil.note.body: Calcium, magnesium and sulfur contribute to different physiological processes in plants.

protego.hero: Technical care for fruit and vegetables.
protego.lead: A technical processing aid based on diatomaceous earth and citric acid, intended for fruit and vegetable treatment.
protego.what.title: Technology supporting food preservation.
protego.what.body: PROTEGO FL was developed to support washing and preservation processes for fresh or processed fruits, vegetables and leafy greens.
protego.what.body2: The product helps limit browning and discoloration and contributes to reducing microbial activity under the specified conditions of use.
protego.benefits.title: Focus on quality and preservation.
protego.benefit1.title: Less browning
protego.benefit1.body: Helps preserve the visual appearance of treated produce.
protego.benefit2.title: Improved preservation
protego.benefit2.body: Helps maintain the quality of fruits and vegetables.
protego.benefit3.title: Microbial activity
protego.benefit3.body: Laboratory tests with PROTEGO FL indicated reduced microorganism levels under the conditions evaluated.
protego.app.title: Versatile options for different produce.
protego.app1.title: Spraying
protego.app1.body: For delicate produce, such as strawberries, under technical guidance.
protego.app2.title: Immersion and washing
protego.app2.body: Methods described for lettuce, tomatoes, apples, grapes and more.
protego.app3.title: Localized treatment
protego.app3.body: Brushing onto specific areas, such as melon stems.
protego.image.title: Application on fruit
protego.image.body: Fruit washing as part of food cleaning and preservation processes.
protego.tech.storage: Dry, ventilated area away from light, heat and moisture
protego.tech.note: Application may vary according to the type of produce. Contact the LIA AGRO technical team for specific guidance.
protego.study.title: Laboratory microbiological evaluation.
protego.study.body: In tests conducted at the Federal University of Rio Grande do Sul (UFRGS), lettuce samples inoculated with microorganisms were treated with a 0.75% PROTEGO FL solution for 10 minutes.
protego.study.caution: Approximate reductions under the specific test conditions. Results may vary with application conditions.
